NONE: › awkward and without grace (= moving smoothly and attractively) in movement
笨手笨腳的；舉止不優雅的
› (of a man's behaviour) not polite and not behaving well towards other people
（行為）不禮貌的，不恰當的

example: He was sent off the pitch for ungentlemanly conduct.
他因行為不當而被罰下場。

NONE: › not glamorous (= especially attractive and exciting)
無趣的，乏味的；沒有吸引力的
› to experience difficulties and fail
失敗，崩潰，瓦解
› to lose control of your emotions or behaviour and become very angry
感情（或行為）失控；心煩意亂

example: When the secret plans came unglued, the president was revealed to have ordered the burglary.
秘密約定敗露後，發現總裁是這件入室盜竊案的主謀。
It was reported that she "came unglued" when she heard of his refusal to cooperate.
據報導，當她得知他拒絕合作後情緒失控。

NONE: › extreme or unacceptable
極端的；不可接受的；不恰當的

example: I had to get up at some ungodly hour in the morning to take her to the airport.
我必須一大早起來送她去機場。

NONE: › unable to be governed or controlled
難管治的；無法控制的；無法約束的
› not grammatical
不符合文法規則的
› not showing or expressing any thanks
不感激的，不領情的
› not guarded or protected
未防備的；無警戒的；未受保護的
› If you make an unguarded remark or say something in an unguarded moment, you tell someone something that you would usually keep secret, sometimes in a way that shows bad judgment.
不留心的；不謹慎的；不防備的

example: You shouldn't leave your bag unguarded like that.
你不能就那樣把你的包放著沒人管。
In an unguarded moment, I said that I didn't trust Charles.
一不留神，我脫口而出說我不信任查爾斯。

NONE: › a thick substance, usually with a pleasant smell, used to treat skin problems or make the skin soft
（有芳香味的）藥膏，油膏，軟膏

example: She smelled powerfully of bath salts and unguents.
她身上有重重的浴鹽和軟膏味。
